display_title: 阿斯加德的陨落: 起源

reviews.text: 首先我要感谢制作组为这款游戏的语言设置里增加了简体中文，万分感谢。也正因此我把它介绍给了我的朋友们。 然而，就目前的情况来看，我并不打算为这款游戏付费。我被游戏的宣传片所吸引，特别是它独特的像素艺术风格。但实际体验后，我发现游戏存在一些需要改进的地方： 1.游戏的画面设置界面居然要玩家在战斗开始后通过按Esc键才能访问，这显然不够直观。我希望能在游戏开始时就直接看到设置选项。 2.世界等级的调整过于繁琐。只能通过按按钮去一次增加/减少一级，但如果设置了一个比较高的世界等级，例如100级时（我是因为好奇世界等级上限才这么做的），想把世界等级调回0级，要将等级降至0级，就只能花费大量时间点击，或者重新开始游戏。建议增加滑块或输入框以提高效率。 3.对于同类游戏而言，这款游戏的战斗内成长过低了。以0技能树且0世界等级的开局为例，当你在世界等级达到5级时，玩家输出的提升就已经开始落后于敌人血量的提升，随着世界等级的继续提升，你会越来越难以清理刷新的敌人，并且只能通过移动去躲避敌人，最终被海一样的敌人堵死在角落。 4.与上一点相对的是，这款游戏的战斗外成长太高了。玩家在技能树上投入数十点技能点后，游戏难度会急剧下降。我认为战斗外成长应该更多地关注新机制的引入（例如吸血鬼幸存者和哈迪斯），而并非只有输出与防御的提升。 5.游戏的难度曲线存在问题。为了使玩家感到愉悦并激发购买欲望，合理的难度曲线是关键。理想的难度曲线应该在游戏中期逐渐增加难度，但在游戏后期，难度应该保持稳定或逐渐降低，以便玩家在完善自己的战斗策略后能从中获得乐趣，而不是单纯地面对不断增加的挑战（毕竟，你们的目标不是创造另一款《黑暗之魂》） My English and German are not very good, so I used a machine translation, hoping there will be no translation errors First of all, I would like to thank the production team for adding Simplified Chinese to the language settings of this game. Thank you very much. That's why I introduced it to my friends. However, based on the current situation, I do not intend to pay for this game. I was attracted by the promotional video of the game, especially its unique pixel art style. But after actual experience, I found that there are some areas in the game that need improvement: 1. The game's screen settings interface actually requires players to access it by pressing the Esc after the Fight starts, which is obviously not intuitive enough. I hope to see the settings options directly at the beginning of the game. 2. Adjusting the world level is too cumbersome. You can only increase/decrease one level at a time by pressing the button, but if you set a higher world level, such as at level 100 (I did this because I was curious about the world level limit), and want to bring the world level back to level 0, you have to spend a lot of time clicking or restarting the game. Suggest adding sliders or input boxes to improve efficiency. 3. For similar games, the in-battle growth of this game is too low. Taking the opening of a 0 skill tree and 0 world level as an example, when you reach level 5 in the world, the player's output improvement begins to lag behind the enemy's health increase. As the world level continues to improve, you will find it increasingly difficult to clean up refreshed enemies and can only dodge them by moving, ultimately being blocked in the corner by sea like enemies. 4. In contrast to the previous point, the growth outside of combat in this game is too high. After players invest dozens of skill points in the skill tree, the difficulty of the game will sharply decrease. I believe that growth outside of combat should focus more on the introduction of new mechanisms (such as Vampire Survivors and Hades), rather than just improving output and defense. 5. There is an issue with the difficulty curve of the game. A reasonable difficulty curve is key to making players feel happy and stimulating their desire to purchase. The ideal difficulty curve should gradually increase in the middle of the game, but in the later stages of the game, the difficulty should remain stable or gradually decrease, so that players can enjoy it after improving their combat strategies, rather than simply facing increasing challenges (after all, your goal is not to create another Dark Soul) Mein Englisch und Deutsch sind nicht sehr gut, also habe ich eine maschinelle Übersetzung verwendet, in der Hoffnung, dass es keine Übersetzungsfehler gibt Zunächst einmal möchte ich dem Produktionsteam danken, dass es vereinfachtes Chinesisch zu den Spracheinstellungen dieses Spiels hinzugefügt hat. Vielen Dank. Deshalb habe ich es meinen Freunden vorgestellt. Aufgrund der aktuellen Situation beabsichtige ich jedoch nicht, für dieses Spiel zu bezahlen. Ich war von dem Werbevideo des Spiels angezogen, vor allem von seinem einzigartigen Pixel Art Stil. Aber nach tatsächlicher Erfahrung habe ich festgestellt, dass es einige Bereiche im Spiel gibt, die verbessert werden müssen: 1. Die Bildschirmeinstellungen des Spiels erfordern tatsächlich, dass Spieler darauf zugreifen, indem sie die Esc drücken, nachdem der Kampf gestartet wurde, was offensichtlich nicht intuitiv genug ist. Ich hoffe, die Einstellungsoptionen direkt zu Beginn des Spiels zu sehen. 2. Die Anpassung des Weltniveaus ist zu umständlich. Du kannst nur ein Level auf einmal erhöhen/verringern, indem du den Knopf drückst, aber wenn du ein höheres Level einstellst, z.B. auf Level 100 (ich habe das getan, weil ich neugierig auf das Level der Welt war) und das Level wieder auf Level 0 bringen willst, musst du viel Zeit damit verbringen, das Spiel zu klicken oder neu zu starten. Fügen Sie Schieberegler oder Eingabefelder hinzu, um die Effizienz zu verbessern. 3. Für ähnliche Spiele ist das Wachstum dieses Spiels im Kampf zu niedrig. Am Beispiel der Eröffnung eines 0-Fähigkeitsbaums und eines 0-Welt-Levels: Wenn du Level 5 in der Welt erreichst, beginnt die Leistungssteigerung des Spielers hinter dem Gesundheitszuwachs des Gegners zurückzubleiben. Während sich das Weltniveau weiter verbessert, wirst du es immer schwieriger finden, aufgefrischte Feinde aufzuräumen und ihnen nur auszuweichen, indem du dich bewegst und schließlich wie Feinde in der Ecke vom Meer blockiert wirst. 4. Im Gegensatz zum vorherigen Punkt ist das Wachstum außerhalb des Kampfes in diesem Spiel zu hoch. Nachdem Spieler Dutzende von Fertigkeitspunkten in den Fertigkeitsbaum investiert haben, wird der Schwierigkeitsgrad des Spiels stark abnehmen. Ich glaube, dass Wachstum außerhalb des Kampfes sich mehr auf die Einführung neuer Mechanismen (wie Vampire Survivors und Hades) konzentrieren sollte, anstatt nur Leistung und Verteidigung zu verbessern. 5. Es gibt ein Problem mit der Schwierigkeitskurve des Spiels. Eine vernünftige Schwierigkeitskurve ist der Schlüssel, um Spieler glücklich zu machen und ihren Kaufwunsch zu stimulieren. Die ideale Schwierigkeitskurve sollte sich in der Mitte des Spiels allmählich erhöhen, aber in den späteren Phasen des Spiels sollte der Schwierigkeitsgrad stabil bleiben oder allmählich abnehmen, damit die Spieler ihn genießen können, nachdem sie ihre Kampfstrategien verbessert haben, anstatt sich einfach zunehmenden Herausforderungen zu stellen (schließlich ist es nicht dein Ziel, eine weitere Dunkle Seele zu erschaffen).
不错 就是目前太依靠技能树 另外部分技能平衡不是很好 输出跟其他技能明显不是同一个等级 更新之后难度合理了不少而且世界层级也改成难度选择了并且加了经验获取 就是boss更新之后会莫名掉血不知道为什么
1，人物和怪物模型太小，看不清楚，冲进怪堆吃经验升级，加点的时候多想了一会，出来忘记人物在哪了，找不到人了，被怪挤死 2，怪物有碰撞体积，也就是说你清得慢了会被怪围死，前期进去就是搬砖，非常难受 3，除了几个环绕技能，其他绝大部分技能包括普通攻击全是随着鼠标指向，不能自动打最近怪 总结，玩了2个多小时，感觉自己像是在坐牢

Yeah. When it comes to leaving the game, you literally have no quit option. You can quit the game your playing, but you know, not the whole game. How am I supposed to get out of this? Unbelievably bad. Plus the settings menu is hidden within the actual game so you have to start playing before you can turn off the music and set graphics settings. What's that about? Gameplay was fine I suppose but offered nothing innovative and failed in basic concepts of bullet hell that I feel are rightfully expected. Needs a lot of work to make it even halfway interesting.

Hopefully the "full version" adds more than just new maps & more skill tree. As of now, the 'core' game play is dull & extremely repetitive. Vampire Survivors has multiple characters for example; many secrets to discover, and more than 3 enemy types per map. This game has 'World Difficulty' without any limit -- seems pointless as even with maxed skills you wouldn't be able to defeat any difficulty above 50.

Awesome BUT... Really cool so far, can't wait to see what they do with the skill tree. However the most annoying thing in the game so far and i hope that they fix it is when an enemy's hit box gets stuck on your character's hit box and you end up dragging that enemy along with you while it's damaging you, until it dies. Who came up with this? It's stupid! Only reason why i haven't wish listed it yet to be honest.

I have never played such an amazing bullet heaven! This is BY FAR the best game in this genre, The difficulty is pretty high but that is slightly reduced by grinding out points for the skill tree. I feel that lightning is slightly overpowered at the minute even though it doesn't have a fully fleshed out skill tree. I can not wait for the full release of this game it is an absolute innovation to the Genre. Pros *Ground breaking addition to the genre *Skill trees are massive and impactful without trivialising the game *Graphics are a gem *Sound track is Top notch *Run variation is great. Cons *Needs some balancing lightning is way stronger than the other trees. *Health pickups can be a bit scarce at times making the later world levels difficult *No controller support as of yet *No ability to remap keys dodge on space is uncomfortable for me Overall This game is an absolute gem and you would be doing yourself a disservice by not playing this free prologue.
Vampire Survivors for poor gaymers.

玩到了27级，总结一下个人观点，算抛砖引玉： 1.物理系只玩的流血，伤害起效慢，但是怪一片片的倒下很爽，丢飞刀和乌鸦的物理技能手感和效果都不好； 2.火焰系伤害很高，精英怪都是被秒，还有一个很实用的天赋--释放火焰技能回血，增加容错性，算是T1； 3.冰霜系很蛋疼，可能开发组为了突显控制而削弱了伤害，导致后期只是冻住怪而非消灭掉，怪数量会积压，增加生存压力； 4.闪电系伤害一般，技能效果也一般，没有深入探究。 最后提几个缺点： 1.谜之物理碰撞体积，与怪接触后没有无敌时间，导致怪会粘着自己疯狂掉血，进入怪堆容易被秒，而且冲刺技能不属于闪现或者幽魂效果，就是纯纯把怪撞开，加之没有无敌时间，操作失误就会被秒； 2.怪的奖励就是纯经验，不够吸引人，而且怪的种类来来去去就那几个，精英怪打完石头人还是石头人，长时间游玩会产生疲劳，建议增加精英怪掉落宝箱，可开出永久或短期的道具、BUFF之类，增加游玩乐趣。 感谢作者，还算不错的游戏，希望越来越好！
不好玩
手感很好，但可惜升级之后的技能构筑太垃圾了，要么cd-10 要么伤害+30 玩了半小时就已经索然无味了，虽然是免费，但我还是得给出我内心真实的想法

Free game to waste some time on. If it's the prologue, when the full game releases, there's a lot of good things going for it. I've noticed that there's no reason to pick up any other element aside from Physical skills: partly because the other trees aren't developed yet, but mostly because your physical damage continues to scale with your level at the moment and the other damage types don't. Once you reach a certain point, even at max world difficulty, you're breezing through content because Physical skills are just that strong. Will be watching for the full game release.

想给个中评，但是没有，那就给个不推荐算了，因为现在体验到的游戏内容确实感觉没啥可推荐给别人的。 咋说呢，玩法太单调了，虽然有物理火电冰啥的几系技能，但实际上游玩体验并不会差多少，因为最能影响角色输出的不是技能，而是属性点。基本上啥玩法都无脑点固伤和双爆就完事了，后期都是站那挂机就能秒怪。还有现阶段好像默认是无限模式，正式版不会每关也都整成无限模式吧，后期想自杀都自杀不了，怪一刷出来就被秒了，我挂机刷到地图层级110多实在无聊得受不了退了。另外局外成长也太狠了，一上来难度2还刮痧呢，结果打完一把20多点天赋点出来最高难度开局已经秒怪了。 感觉游戏不是数值设计的问题，是底层逻辑有问题，靠升级堆数值成长的幸存者最后肯定会变成各种流派体验都差不多。我觉得类幸存者游戏中有趣的玩点的是不同流派能有不同玩法和攻击手段，再加上一些rogue道具或者双技能搭配能够改变技能形态，但在游戏现有的底层逻辑下就算实现了也没啥玩点，因为你可以依靠最简单的终极手段——堆数值赢得游戏，那就没啥意思了啊。

Understanding that this is an early alpha on an entirely different engine, I still cannot recommend this game. It's got the *idea* of a Bullet-Heaven down, but lacks nearly all the core components to making it actually FUN. You guys and gals need to sit down, and play a few other of your competitors titles, because while this one feels competently made (no crashes, only minor hitbox issues) you've somehow managed to bungle nearly all the parts that make these games fun. Level ups should feel like a jackpot or pachinko "hit", upgrades should be meaningful, and significantly boost the stats they're increasing, or change the way the run plays. My 3 choices for a skill I picked should not consist of 30% more damage, 10% cooldown, or +1 more instance only. I understand you can't up the area of the skills in the small arena you have in the demo, because you'd risk making the AoE hit the entire map, but hey, maybe make the map bigger? Difficulty should not be a metric of how much HP the monsters have, other genre's get called out for this BS, and the term "bullet sponge" is apt. Difficulty settings should not consist of +10% xp for 50% more monster HP (this just makes it worse). Your first monster that runs slightly faster than the player should not be the most dangerous in the game. There should be a clear indication of what the player is working towards in the run, either a time limit, or a boss, or X number of bosses, check out Soulstone Survivors for this, they've got the idea down pat. Hell, the skill tree has upgrades that are both no-brainers and items that should be skills instead of skill tree upgrades. Wedding Witch does this better and it's only a bit more complex in the run choices. Ultimately, figure out some of the ideas, cause the early blood economy for the runes making you make choices is great, but falls apart after a half dozen levels when you can afford it all. The game's World Level should never start leveling up faster than the player, or even feel like it might be. This is going to take a lot of polish to live up to the lovely pixel art you have made up.

Another uninspired Survivors game. I died multiple times to boredom since I would just space out as I walked in circles. You can find better versions of this type of game for free on web-based platforms. I wouldn't be optimistic about the development path changing it into a great game.
纯数值的肉鸽，后续更新看不到希望
作为类幸存者游戏，最大的缺陷是爽不起来，我火焰技能树点满只有数值的变化，而小怪的数量一直很多，数值有涨的厉害，导致我要一直精神紧绷的操作，每一局累的要死正反馈还低，还要调整
过于坐牢，缺乏特殊机制，核心就是个放风筝，也不爽快，有些无聊。
角色不显眼，在后面技能满天飞的时候，看不到自己
游戏性低，变化少，刷起来又臭又长

目前角色等级有三十多级了，物理技能树基本点满，下面说说我的看法： 1、前期推荐使用冰系，优先把冰吐息给点出来，除冰系外其他伤害成长速率都太低了，伤害跟不上怪血量增长； 2、14级之后换成物理，一路向上点，点出流血死亡爆炸的时候这个游戏基本上就通关了。优先选择匕首，然后世界等级20层左右站在地图的一个角落挂机就ok，隔一段时间去捡捡球，可以一路刷到电脑没电或者不想玩为止。我挂到135层的时候感到很无聊了，视线内根本看不到怪，怪在界面外就被秒掉了，Boss也一样； 3、攻击速度是可以减技能冷却的，我一开始不知道，多玩了几把才开窍。之前一直以为只加普攻速度。
好更新，更新前玩了六个小时，更新后玩了两坨大的，技能进化后奇葩刷新概率，减CD：增伤=0：50+，这算什么肉鸽。之前是一轮一轮的boss，确实很像不停休的战争，现在直接照抄别人20分钟死神，怎么？那我为啥不玩你的前辈游戏，别人还更成熟
有种幸存者刀塔化的赶脚，输出太捉急，只能靠冰山雷电控制走位烧操作续命。技能树不少，期待正式版

30级，新加入的技能进化可圈可点，暂时只玩了物理系的进化 1，匕首的进化增加了弹射物但很大一部分的弹射物打不中导致输出浪费 2，爪击的进化只是更改了模型个人感觉范围甚至没有原来的大 3，乌鸦的进化增加的羽毛好多都打不中怪 4，地刺只增加的攻击频率和技能的判定范围？ 5，旋风剑这个是最让我无语的一个进化，变成两个环绕自身的剑，攻击频率大幅度降低甚至不如进化前的输出高 然后就是20分钟的限时，难度拉满不到50层就结束了，难度中等的情况也就50+结束这个限时不如改成增加一个强力boss 还有技能树的狂暴，纸面上写的击杀加攻速最高50%但我特意去试了一下105%的基础攻速最高就到145% 以及模糊的流血燃烧伤害 总结，技能进化还有限时的情况让我不是很想玩下去 就这样了，很荣幸游玩这个游戏
20分钟太长了，最后好不容易坚持到20分钟，odin飞过来一雷劈死，欲哭无泪。
缺点该写的都写了，数值化太僵硬，没有一些技能的羁绊和属性增减的乐趣，可以参考下其他游戏，比如土豆兄弟和末日幸存者之类。特别点名托尔之怒，满级后严重遮挡视线，一定要改！技能树和技能附加属性也要考虑改改。 游戏的手感画风都比较喜欢，希望作者奋发努力，做大做强！
没有无尽，太依赖升级技能树了，试玩版各元素前面能玩玩，等级高了还是得物理伤害，建议只点2-3个技能，流血死亡爆炸尽快升级点出来，然后配个投掷匕首为主技能，无脑刷就完了。。。。然后就，，没什么可玩性了，后期怪多的时候偶尔有点卡（i9-14900hx+4060top显卡），肉鸽类小游戏，休闲耍耍完事。

I honestly think that the game has a nice concept, the graphics are pretty and I enjoyed the idea of a Norse roguelike, I also had no performance issues no matter how many enemies were on the arena but... The game offers no challenge whatsoever. Given that someone played other games similar to this one like Brotato, Vampire Survivors etc. one will find this game simply boring. It's because the enemies, especialy on the hardest difficulty which I tried the game on are but punching bags. You simply run big circles around the arena and the enemies pose no threat because they can neither catch up to you, nor have any attacks that would be tricky, force you to dodge or even change direction. All you have to do is to run forward and even if you do happen to get hit, the sheer amount of healing apples will surely be enough to make up for the health lose. After 12 minutes of running I switched the game off because I didn't think any enemy would change my impression of the gameplay. Also the coursor gets hardly visible on the arena swarming with enemies. With that being said, my perspective is that of a veteran of the genre. I believe that players less experienced with this kind of games can and will have a lot of fun playing. What's more, this is a game in development so everything can and hopefuly will get rethought so that the increase in difficulty is more meaningful than lazy increase in health. For those reasons I'm giving thumbs down but I'll come back and try the game in the future to see if it changed for the better.
感觉很一般，玩个3-5把以后就非常无聊，整个流程就是刷经验，加技能树，战斗就是跑圈，在类幸存者里属于没有什么自己特色的一款。 不能算非常烂，但确实是不及格。
缺点是有的，不同系别的强度有差，新手别碰冰系，也可能是三系的技能树未完善。 整体画风不错，明明是偶尔玩一局放松，但一小局20分钟玩了更累了（例如霓虹是越打越爽），可以出点其他模式。
杀敌达到一定数量的成就比较耗时，每局20分钟，最后见到骑马的敌人，应该是Odin，玩家打不了，对方直接秒杀玩家，一局结束。升级加点，开始下一局。基本2个小时左右就开始无聊了。
玩了5.6小时，大概二十几把游戏，每把是固定20分钟左右，解锁了两条技能树，虽然是不完整版，但依旧值得期待。希望后续可以开放不同英雄，增加每个英雄的特定技能。boss的奖励仅为一次技能宝箱，等同于一次升级。相对于boss的难度，感觉这个奖励有点微不足道，应该改成随机装备 或者随机特效（区别于升级所能选的技能）

首先，我只是一个普通玩家，玩游戏就是为了开心。 这款游戏非常有意思，但我对物理类技能旋风劈斩的进化非常不满意，在进化之前，我可以体验到一秒一刀甚至更多砍杀的快刀斩乱麻的爽感，但是进化后的光环不仅形态与乌鸦类似，而且失去了最重要的极速砍杀了乐趣，费心进化该技能的回报非常令人失望，我只能选择不拾取进化箱子。希望它的进化可以变得更有旋风斩自己的特色与帅气的特效。 非常期待完整版的推出。
可玩性太少了，天赋树升到二三十级就无脑过最高难度了，还有就是有些技能不合理，技能进化前的升级对进化后的没加成，太死板，技能之间也没化学反应，望改变

以目前的情况来说，作为一个幸存者类型的游戏，我没有发现任何突出特色或是优点，缺点倒是不缺。 比如，怪物种类太少了，虽然现在是试玩版，只有一张图，怪物种类少也是理所应当，但第一张图那几只怪，前期怪和后期怪的区别在哪呢？在贴图，真的就只是贴图换了血加厚点，别的一模一样的，攻击方式完全没变，连范围距离以及攻击飞行速度都是一模一样，就只是换了个贴图，第一张图都这样换皮，后面会是怎么样也是可以预见的。 过程很无聊，基本上就是绕着地图转圈圈，只要转圆圈基本上什么都不用管，就转20分钟打完图。 技能之间缺少协调性，很多技能升级也基本上没多少提升，不同种类技能之间不会因为组合不同而产生化学反应，升级也没什么质变的，也就是说实际上这游戏的技能说是几十种，但实际上玩不出什么花样来，随你怎么换技能，玩起来还是一模一样的。 总之，这游戏没有一个能够让人觉得应该选择它的理由，也没有把大家都能做到的部分做得很好，实在是很难勾起购买欲望。

Asgard's Fall: Origins – Review Asgard's Fall: Origins had potential on paper but failed to deliver anything worth your time. The game is repetitive from early on, the gameplay loop gets stale fast, and there was not a single moment that made me want to keep going. It felt like a chore to push through rather than an experience to enjoy. A few things that did not work: 1- The repetition is relentless. Every session feels identical to the last with nothing new introduced to break the cycle. 2- There is no hook. Nothing pulls you back in or makes you feel invested in what you are doing. 3/10 one of those games that is hard to recommend to anyone. Skip it
